thread:
maria (Sales): Hey team, ACME just asked for a committed capacity proposal. They want predictable latency for a customer-facing chat feature. Can we size reserved GPUs + autoscale recommendation?

ajay (Solutions): Thanks Maria. Do we have expected QPS and tokens per request from the PO?

maria (Sales): They gave an initial POC target: 120 QPS sustained, 300 QPS burst for 10m, avg generation ~220 tokens, max context 2048. SLA target: p95 < 400ms generation time.

sophie (ML Eng): With 220 tokens avg, model choice matters. If they use a 13B quantized model we typically see ~60-90 tokens/sec per A100 (approx). For 220 tokens that's ~2.5s single-threaded unless we batch. We should use batching + KV cache. For throughput: rough calc -> 120 QPS * 220 tokens = 26,400 tokens/sec. With batching we can amortize kernel overhead. Estimate 3 x A100-80GB with continuous batching and optimized kernels to hit p95 350-400ms if we tune batch sizes.

dave (Infra): Quick mapping: for Dedicated reserved pool: 3 reserved A100s baseline, autoscale policy to add 2 more on sustained queue > 60s or CPU/GPU util > 75% for 5m. Allow burst to up to 6 GPUs for 15m windows to cover the 300 QPS spikes.

maria (Sales): That sounds reasonable. How do we present pricing? They'll ask committed discount vs on-demand.

kevin (Acct Exec): For a 3-reserved GPU commit we typically propose a monthly commit with ~35-40% discount vs hourly on-demand; autoscale usage billed at a smaller premium when exceeded. I'll draft numbers after infra confirms exact configs.

ajay (Solutions): Also flag the operational tradeoffs: reserved capacity reduces cold-start risk and ensures latency SLO, but customer still needs to accept occasional fallback to smaller model variants if autoscale can't keep up during extreme bursts. Add explicit fallback policy in the SOW.

sophie (ML Eng): For the POC we should run a small loadtest: 1) baseline single A100 with batching profile, 2) 3x A100 baseline, 3) autoscale to 5 GPUs and verify p95. I can provide the workloads and scripts. We'll need a sample prompt set from ACME to mimic token distribution.

maria (Sales): ACME legal also asked for security questionnaire answers re: data isolation for Dedicated. Pointed Q about network egress and KMS/HSM for keys.

dave (Infra): Dedicated has VPC peering option + private control plane. We support KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and HSM for Enterprise. We'll include: disk encryption, in-transit TLS, per-tenant network isolation. I'll attach the canned answers.

maria (Sales): Great. Anything blocking timeline for a 2-week POC starting next Tue?

sophie (ML Eng): Need model artifact access from ACME (weights or they pick from our model catalog), plus prompt set. Also need a signed DPA and short infra whitelist for IPs.

ajay (Solutions): I'll coordinate the SOW items and draft a runbook for the POC: phases (smoke, ramp, soak), success criteria (p95 <= 400ms at 120 QPS sustained, correctness QA pass rate >= 95%), rollback triggers.

kevin (Acct Exec): Heads up: procurement may want the reserved commit to be annual. We can do monthly-to-quarterly for POC, but enterprise discounts assume 12-month commit.

dave (Infra): Autoscaling config we usually suggest (example):

```
policy: {
  min_reserved_gpus: 3,
  max_gpus: 6,
  scale_up_if_queue_seconds > 30 for 60s,
  scale_down_if_idle > 300s,
  burst_window_minutes: 15
}
```

This is just a template — exact thresholds tuned during POC.

maria (Sales): Perfect. Sophie, can you estimate SRE/ops support hours for the POC so I can include in the quote?

sophie (ML Eng): We'll need ~12h setup (model + pipelines), 8h load-test tuning, 6h post-analysis => estimate 26 engineer hours. Add 6h on-call during soak.

ajay (Solutions): Also include a line about rollback/fallback policies: auto-fallback to smaller quantized model (latency-optimized) after X misses, and traffic split for canary.

kevin (Acct Exec): I'll prepare two pricing rows: (A) 3x reserved GPUs monthly commit + autoscale buffer to 6 (B) 5x reserved GPUs for higher assurance with lower autoscale. Include PO terms for annual commit discount.

maria (Sales): Anything from security/gov we should flag? ACME is banking-related, they asked about audit logs retention and SOC2 scope.

dave (Infra): We have audit logs retention add-on; SOC2 attestation available. For Private (on-prem) option we can offer more control but that's longer lead time. Flag to ACME: dedicated hosted + VPC + KMS is usually acceptable for banking POCs.

maria (Sales): Cool. Action items: ajay draft SOW + runbook, kevin draft pricing rows, dave attach security answers + infra template, sophie supply loadtest scripts and hours. POC start target next Tue.

ajay (Solutions): I'll have a first SOW draft by EOD tomorrow.

sophie (ML Eng): I'll prepare the k6/locust scripts and a sample batch config.

dave (Infra): Sending security snippets and the autoscale template to this thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled test cluster reserved: 3 x A100 (staging) will be provisioned at 2025-09-28T08:00Z for POC.

maria (Sales): Awesome — thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll sync with ACME tomorrow 10am PT and present this plan.

kevin (Acct Exec): One more ask — include an explicit clause about burst protection costs so they understand billing for autoscale usage.

maria (Sales): Noted. Closing loop after SOW draft.
